headline: New Zealand dollar touches 17-year low against major trading partner basket
summary: The New Zealand dollar declined to a 17-year low against a trade-weighted basket of major currencies, posing mixed implications for domestic importers and exporters.
why: A weaker kiwi dollar enhances competitiveness for commodity exports like dairy and forestry, but increases imported inflation costs for consumer goods and energy.

impacts.name: New Zealand Dollar
impacts.why: The kiwi fell to its lowest level against a trade-weighted basket in 17 years.
